runtime/regex#

The native layer under regex/escape, regex/match, regex/pattern, regex/replace: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under regex/escape, regex/match, regex/pattern, regex/replace: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.
